attributes.name: dropdown submenu static visibility
attributes.definition: Whether dropdown navigation items reveal their submenu contents in the default (non-interacted) state, or only show an indicator.

values.definition: Dropdown items show only a caret/arrow indicator; submenu hidden in static state.
Submenu contents are visible in the static state.
No dropdown navigation items present or not addressed.

attributes.name: navigation list markup
attributes.definition: The semantic HTML structure used for navigation and link groups.

values.definition: Navigation/link groups use ul/li list elements.
Links are grouped with divs, spans or bare anchors, not lists.
